notes: 2026-07-24: Created from scratch, merging all 30 rows from the founder-provided 'social_media_digital_marketing_agency_resources.csv' (Section II.40). Three independently-verified, directly on-topic replacements were substituted to reach 10 channels: Buffer, Techpoint Africa, and NairametricsTV. 2026-08-23: Added 27 high-confidence openly licensed textbook records from the Open Textbook Library catalog; records were limited to titles with a non-empty license and a $0.00 Online, PDF, or eBook format.
